source: Uncommitted schema009 security checkpoint; hashes identify tested source rather than the earlier published native/browser candidate.

postgresql.runtimeDispatchRole: Separate non-owner NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS credential in all eleven PostgreSQL scenarios
postgresql.ownerUsedFor: Synthetic fixture setup, independent assertions and permission/revocation mutations only

checks: Durable dedupe, conflicting key rejection and absent provider blocked without fabricated receipt
Fresh account/membership/grant/preferences/entity policy and London DST quiet-hour checks
Same provider business key after response loss and reopen
Concurrent workers claim once; external provider wait retains no SQL transaction or ambient logical authority
Expired non-idempotent provider outcome requires review
Protected claim returns original payload and canonical stored ancestry
Exact job and recipient metadata only; scheduling capability cannot read match state
Wrong capability, job, team or season cannot read job/account/document rows
Worker cannot forge API identity/actor context through context JSON
Category rewrite, token hash rekey and lease extension rejected by PostgreSQL
Stale logical timestamp cannot extend lease past actual database clock
Database alone chooses due/reclaim time and lease; caller clock is only a ±30-second observation
A tolerated +25-second observation cannot advance recipient eligibility or accepted receipt time
Fresh database observations around evidence/lease/outcome avoid inheriting claim response latency; expired recipient during a controlled 20ms repository delay is suppressed
provider: Explicit test double only; no APNs/FCM receipt or device-delivery proof
